newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Five Star says holds 50.8 pct of Paladin.
newsitem.headline: Five Star says holds 50.8 pct of Paladin.

text.p: Five Star Investments Ltd held 284.42 million shares or 50.8 percent of the share capital of property investment concern Paladin Ltd as on Monday, the companies said in a joint statement on Tuesday.

Five Star Investments in August launched a cash offer for Paladin shares after Five Star's controlling shareholder James Oung completed an injection of property asset into the company, resulting in his stake in Paladin increasing to 44.88 percent.
The cash offer of HK$0.83 per share will remain open until October 7, the statement said.
Oung was formerly the chairman of a Taiwan polyester and nylon products maker Hualon Corp.
Paladin shares rose two cents to HK$0.83 in late morning on volume of 2.90 million shares.
